$comment: This schema defines the structure for UAG reserves data.

discord_id.description: The Discord ID of the member joining the reserves.

start_date.description: The start date of the reserve period in YYMMDD format.

end_date.description: The end date of the reserve period in YYMMDD format.

reason.description: The reason for going into reserves.

notified_on.description: The date a staff member was notified about the reserve.

approved_by.description: The Discord ID of the staff member who approved the reserve request.
